message: Nothing was changed: 9 blocks cannot be moved by X1.5 Y-2: 5 blocks in or opening a frame, 1 coordinate shift or setting, 1 subprogram or macro call, 1 block with a variable or calculation in a moved word, 1 free contour (FK). findings.message: 5 CYCL DEF 7.1 X+10: this sets or shifts the coordinate system or writes offsets (a local shift, a coordinate set, a data setting that changes offsets); gEdit does not move the values it sets, so the positions after it would no longer match the moved path.
7 FL X+20 Y+30 AN+45: a free contour (FK): its points depend on each other and on the elements around them; gEdit does not move them.
8 L X+Q1 Y+5: a variable or a calculation in a word the transform has to change; gEdit only changes written numbers.
9 CALL LBL 5: a subprogram or macro call: the called program's positions are not in this document, so it cannot be moved with the rest.

10 PLANE SPATIAL SPA+0 SPB+30 SPC+0 TURN MB MAX FMAX: a coordinate rotation, mirror, scaling, polar command or tilted plane is in force here; gEdit cannot tell where these positions are. Move the path without it, or cancel it first.
